Introduction: Presentation and description of the Learning Situation

odeComponent.htmlView:
Welcome to our Halloween project, where students will become creators, problem-solvers, and performers in English!

In this learning situation, 2nd ESO students will explore the origins and traditions of Halloween while developing their English language skills through interactive and collaborative activities. Throughout the project, they will learn key vocabulary, practise useful grammar structures, and take part in challenges such as quizzes and breakout games.

The final goal of the project is to design and carry out a haunted house experience for 1st ESO students. Working in teams, students will create scenes, characters, and interactive moments using both digital tools and their creativity, turning the classroom into a spooky but educational experience.

This project aims to make learning meaningful, motivating, and fun, while encouraging cooperation, communication in English, and the use of digital tools in a safe and responsible way.

Get ready… if you dare! 👻

odeComponent.htmlView:
For the development of the final product of this learning situation, in which 2nd ESO students will design a haunted house experience in English for 1st ESO students during Halloween, digital tools such as Canva and Genially will be used.

Through these tools, students will be able to create visual and interactive materials related to the project, such as posters, presentations, breakout-style challenges or digital elements to decorate and organise the different scenes of the haunted house experience.

On the one hand, Canva stands out for being an intuitive and user-friendly tool, suitable for 2nd ESO students with an intermediate level of digital competence. In addition, it allows students to design attractive visual resources that encourage creativity, motivation and active participation.

On the other hand, Genially enables the creation of interactive content and gamified activities, such as games, challenges and quizzes, which perfectly fit the theme of the project and promote active and cooperative learning.

Both tools are accessible within the educational environment and encourage collaborative work, helping students develop not only their digital competence, but also their autonomy and creativity.

odeComponent.htmlView:
In this section, you will find a selection of carefully chosen digital resources that will help you complete the different tasks of this project successfully.

We have used two main tools to organise and share these materials. On the one hand, the teacher’s board in Symbaloo includes useful websites, videos, and teaching resources to guide the learning process. On the other hand, the student board in Padlet brings together all the key materials you will need, such as vocabulary tools, tutorials, and interactive activities.

These platforms will help you access information in an organised and visual way, making it easier to find what you need at each stage of the project and supporting your learning in a more autonomous way.

odeComponent.htmlView:
In groups, you will design your own haunted house experience for students of 1st ESO. You will decide the scenes, characters, and script, and organise how everything will happen during the final performance. You will have two sessions to plan everything carefully.

You will decide:

-The different rooms or scenes of the haunted house
-The characters (ghosts, witches, visitors, etc.)
-The storyline of the experience
-The dialogues and interactions
-The visual design and atmosphere

Your final goal is to create an immersive experience for 1st ESO students using English as the main language of communication.

Use your creativity and make sure everyone in the group participates and contributes.

To promote organization, I encourage you to share a Padlet Board witn your group.

By PactoVisual. Pixabay License.

Help

Useful expressions for your dialogues:


You must use English during the performance. Here are some helpful expressions:

👻 Entering the haunted house
Welcome to the haunted house… if you dare!
Don’t go in there… it’s dangerous!
Are you ready for the challenge?
 
😱 Giving instructions or warnings
You must find the key to escape!
Be careful, the ghost is watching you!
Follow the clues to survive!

You will present your haunted house experience to 1st ESO students the 30th of October in the Library. You will act out your scenes and interact in English, creating a fun and spooky learning experience for your audience.

Work as a team, speak clearly, and enjoy the performance!
